summary: Icecure Medical Ltd. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to register up to $4,339,697 of ordinary shares for an at-the-market (ATM) offering through sales agent A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), with shares sold on Nasdaq at prevailing market prices. There are no special-situation terms such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or activist campaign. The filing reflects routine capital raising for a public company, not a special situation.
